concept: Quick family trip: PIT -> Irvine (parents) -> San Diego (cousin Stefi) -> PIT

san_diego.purpose: Visit cousin Stefi, fly out of SAN

option_1_LAX_nonstop.label: LAX Nonstop (Carissa's preference)
pros: Evening arrival = no traffic on I-405
cons: Only late afternoon departures available nonstop

option_2_SNA_connecting.label: SNA Connecting (closer to Irvine)
option_2_SNA_connecting.notes: No nonstop PIT->SNA exists. Must connect.
pros: SNA is right next to parents
More of the day in Irvine

option_3_LAX_connecting.label: LAX Connecting (arrive earlier)
option_3_LAX_connecting.notes: Take a connecting flight to LAX to arrive earlier than the nonstop
option_3_LAX_connecting.drive_LAX_to_irvine: 45-90 min (daytime traffic on I-405 can be brutal)
pros: Arrive earlier, more time in Irvine
cons: Connection + LAX traffic is a double penalty
Daytime I-405 could add 30-45 min vs evening

return_april_19.critical_note: NO nonstops SAN->PIT in April. Breeze starts May 2026, Southwest starts June 2026. All options are connecting flights.

common_connections.notes: Lots of SAN->DEN options, DEN->PIT nonstop on United. Good hub.
SAN->PHX is short (1hr), PHX->PIT nonstop on American.
Multiple SAN->ORD, ORD->PIT tons of nonstops.
SAN->MDW, then MDW->PIT nonstop on Southwest.

return_april_19.departure_time_preference: Mid-morning ideal — gives a relaxed last morning in SD, arrive PIT by evening
return_april_19.price_est: $150-300 one-way per person depending on airline/connection

layout_A.name: 2 nights Irvine, 1 night SD
schedule: Apr 16 (Thu): Fly PIT -> LAX/SNA, arrive Irvine evening. Night 1 in Irvine.
Apr 17 (Fri): Full day in Irvine with parents. Night 2 in Irvine.
Apr 18 (Sat): Morning in Irvine, drive to SD (~1.5hr). Afternoon/evening with Stefi. Night 3 in SD.
Apr 19 (Sun/Mon): Morning in SD, fly SAN -> PIT (connecting).
pros: Saturday evening in SD is fun (Gaslamp etc)

layout_B.name: 1 night Irvine, 2 nights SD
schedule: Apr 16 (Thu): Fly PIT -> LAX/SNA, arrive Irvine evening. Night 1 in Irvine.
Apr 17 (Fri): Morning with parents, drive to SD after lunch (~1.5hr). Afternoon in SD. Night 2 in SD.
Apr 18 (Sat): Full day in SD with Stefi. Night 3 in SD.
Apr 19 (Mon): Morning in SD, fly SAN -> PIT.
cons: Only 1 morning with parents before driving

layout_C.name: 2 nights Irvine, SD day trip (no hotel)
schedule: Apr 16 (Thu): Fly PIT -> LAX/SNA, arrive Irvine evening. Night 1 in Irvine.
Apr 17 (Fri): Full day in Irvine with parents. Night 2 in Irvine.
Apr 18 (Sat): Drive to SD morning, full day with Stefi, drive back to Irvine evening. Night 3 in Irvine.
Apr 19 (Mon): Drive Irvine -> SAN (1.5hr), fly SAN -> PIT.
cons: 3+ hours round trip driving on Saturday
Need to drive Irvine->SAN on departure day

layout_D.name: Fly into SAN first, reverse direction
schedule: Apr 16 (Thu): Fly PIT -> SAN (connecting). Night 1 in SD with Stefi.
Apr 17 (Fri): Day in SD. Drive to Irvine afternoon/evening. Night 2 in Irvine.
Apr 18 (Sat): Full day in Irvine with parents. Night 3 in Irvine.
layout_D.note: PROBLEM: return from SNA has no nonstops to PIT either. And LAX nonstop departs ~6pm (lose the whole day). This layout is worse because you lose flexibility on BOTH ends.
layout_D.verdict: Eliminated — worse flight options in both directions

recommendation.best_flight_combo: PIT->LAX nonstop (American 5:42pm) + SAN->PIT connecting through DEN or PHX
recommendation.best_layout: Layout A or B depending on priority (parents vs SD time)
recommendation.key_tradeoff: The only nonstop option is outbound PIT->LAX, but it arrives late. To arrive earlier, must accept a connection. Return from SAN is connecting regardless.
